About me

I am a PhD candidate in Astronomy at the Kavli Institute for Astronomy and Astrophysics (KIAA), Peking University, supervised by Prof. Linhua Jiang. I expect to complete my PhD in 2027.

My research focuses on AGN–host galaxy co-evolution. I use optical and near-infrared spectroscopy, high-resolution imaging, and forward modeling to recover quasar host properties and study black-hole growth. My recent work covers spectrophotometric decomposition, changing-look AGNs, Paschen-line black-hole mass calibration, and host stellar kinematics.

I received my BSc in Astronomy from Nanjing University in 2022 and was an exchange PhD student at Heidelberg University’s Institute for Theoretical Physics from September 2025 to September 2026.
